mapper.select: SELECT tp.trip_plan_id, tp.user_id, tp.anchor_content_id, tp.title, tp.trip_date, tp.visit_start_time, tp.visit_end_time, tp.save_yn, tp.ai_yn, tp.transport_md, tp.food_preference, tp.meal_type, tp.lunch_food_preference, tp.dinner_food_preference, tp.cafe_yn, tp.search_dates, tp.search_categories, tp.search_district, tp.search_free_yn, tp.headcount, tp.created_at, tp.upd_at, e.event_name AS anchor_event_name FROM trip_plan tp JOIN event e ON e.event_content_id = tp.anchor_content_id WHERE tp.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId}

SELECT tp.trip_plan_id, tp.user_id, tp.anchor_content_id, tp.title, tp.trip_date, tp.visit_start_time, tp.visit_end_time, tp.save_yn, tp.ai_yn, tp.transport_md, tp.food_preference, tp.meal_type, tp.lunch_food_preference, tp.dinner_food_preference, tp.cafe_yn, tp.search_dates, tp.search_categories, tp.search_district, tp.search_free_yn, tp.headcount, tp.created_at, tp.upd_at FROM trip_plan tp WHERE tp.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.seq_order, ti.item_type, ti.event_content_id, ti.place_content_id, ti.start_time, ti.duration_min, ti.ai_reason, ti.time_fix_yn, COALESCE(e.event_name, p.place_name) AS name, COALESCE(e.addr, p.addr) AS addr, COALESCE(e.mapx, p.mapx) AS mapx, COALESCE(e.mapy, p.mapy) AS mapy, COALESCE(e.image_url, p.image_url) AS image_url, p.open_time, p.close_time, p.break_open_time, p.break_close_time, CASE WHEN p.tour_cat3_code = 'A05020900' THEN 'CAFE' ELSE p.cuisine_type END AS cuisine_type FROM trip_item ti LEFT JOIN event e ON ti.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_content_id = ti.event_content_id LEFT JOIN place p ON ti.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.content_id = ti.place_content_id WHERE ti.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} ORDER BY ti.seq_order
SELECT content_id, place_name AS name, display_yn FROM place WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND content_type_cd = 39
SELECT event_content_id AS content_id, event_name AS name, display_yn, event_start_date, event_end_date, event_start_time FROM event WHERE event_content_id = #{eventContentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_item SET seq_order = #{seqOrder}, item_type = #{itemType}, event_content_id = #{eventContentId}, place_content_id = #{placeContentId}, start_time = #{startTime}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, ai_reason = #{aiReason}, time_fix_yn = #{timeFixYn} WHERE trip_item_id = #{tripItemId} AND trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_item (trip_plan_id, seq_order, item_type, event_content_id, place_content_id, start_time, duration_min, ai_reason, time_fix_yn) VALUES (#{tripPlanId}, #{seqOrder}, #{itemType}, #{eventContentId}, #{placeContentId}, #{startTime}, #{durationMin}, #{aiReason}, #{timeFixYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_plan SET save_yn = TRUE WHERE trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} AND save_yn = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT event_content_id, event_name, event_type, district_name, event_place, date_text, free_yn, display_yn, event_start_date, event_end_date, event_start_time, event_end_time, mapx, mapy FROM event WHERE event_content_id = #{eventContentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_plan (user_id, anchor_content_id, title, trip_date, visit_start_time, visit_end_time, save_yn, ai_yn, transport_md, food_preference, meal_type, lunch_food_preference, dinner_food_preference, cafe_yn, search_dates, search_categories, search_district, search_free_yn, headcount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{anchorContentId}, #{title}, #{tripDate}, #{visitStartTime}, #{visitEndTime}, FALSE, #{aiYn}, #{transportMd}, #{foodPreference}, #{mealType}, #{lunchFoodPreference}, #{dinnerFoodPreference}, COALESCE(#{cafeYn}, FALSE), #{searchDates}, #{searchCategories}, #{searchDistrict}, #{searchFreeYn}, #{headcount})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_plan SET trip_date = #{tripDate}, visit_start_time = #{visitStartTime}, visit_end_time = #{visitEndTime}, transport_md = #{transportMd}, food_preference = #{foodPreference}, meal_type = #{mealType}, lunch_food_preference = #{lunchFoodPreference}, dinner_food_preference = #{dinnerFoodPreference}, cafe_yn = COALESCE(#{cafeYn}, FALSE), search_dates = #{searchDates}, search_categories = #{searchCategories}, search_district = #{searchDistrict}, search_free_yn = #{searchFreeYn}, anchor_content_id = #{anchorContentId}, title = #{title}, ai_yn = #{aiYn} WHERE trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} AND save_yn = FALSE
